decision_rule_before_add108_tier2b: Written 2026-10-06 ~19:52, before any add108 tier2b result.

swap108 is out as the general settled model: on tier2b its recipe is significantly worse than keep96's (101 vs 107; 0 vs 6 discordant, exact McNemar p = 0.031), even though it beat keep96 on the judge set (164 vs 153, p = 0.027).

add108 replaces keep96 if, on tier2b with the same harness and seeds, neither its recipe nor its single shot is significantly worse than keep96's (paired exact McNemar p >= 0.10, or add108 solves at least as many). Its practice-set gain (recipe 153 vs 147) is in-sample, so it is a tiebreak, not evidence on its own.
Otherwise keep96 stays the settled model.
A judge-set confirmation of add108 would be its own pre-registered single look, proposed to the owner and not run automatically.
